test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.
A word formed by rearranging the letters of another word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Anagram**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Anagram"** refers to a word or phrase that is formed by rearranging the letters of another word or phrase. (शब्द परिवर्तित करके बनाया गया नया शब्द)
 
 
• **Example:** The word "listen" can be rearranged to form the anagram "silent".
 
 
• An anagram is a creative linguistic tool often used in puzzles or word games.
 
• Hence, the word **"Anagram"** is the correct answer. (शब्द परिवर्तित कर बनाए गए रूप को "Anagram" कहते हैं।)
